items.claim: Ian Garry could compromise Islam Makhachev's leg early in the fight, but could be finished later because he slows down.
items.quote: I could see Ian stomping Islam and hurting his knee or compromise his leg early in the fight, but Ian could be very well finished later because he slows down.

items.claim: Charles Oliveira is a better win than Ian Garry because Oliveira actually won a title.
items.quote: I think Oliveira's a better win than Ian Garry. I mean, Oliveira's actually won a title. Garry actually hasn't really won anything.
